content.primaryPurpose: Improve the quality of complete common-harness consumer outcomes with bounded, source-grounded AIP Evolve methodology; Ponytail is a candidate treatment and CI Workflow Agent is one additional sub-scope.
userMandates: Quality takes priority over task time.
Lead selects several complex scenarios from existing verification records.
Improve the actual recorded baseline against independently fixed quality criteria.
This session owns the E2E interview and hierarchical Work coordination.
No further commits without user instruction; no changes to other active Work owners.

invariantEligibility: Evidence provenance and relevant source/version/actual exposure are sufficient for the claim.
Native/source/data ownership, original decisions/history and completed/uncertain effect fences are preserved.
Applicable native permissions and admitted resource limits remain with their owners.
targetOutcomes: Required behavior is correct for the independently declared case.
The actual consumer path completes the intended task and preserves necessary purpose/meaning.
Normative originals, Spec/Plan revisions, IDs and dependencies retain their exact relationships.
Changed producers and consumers interoperate under the real public contracts.
Interruption, uncertainty and later continuation preserve the next safe action.
Observed output, verification, evaluator judgment and accountable acceptance remain distinct.

Use existing Git/GitHub commits,trees,branches,worktrees,semantic transition checks and expected-ref CAS for Git-owned publication/concurrency/history; avoid inventing a universal byte-level filesystem prerequisite. Preserve necessary native source guards and separately scoped native apply.
qualityLayers.noCompensation: No time, token, footprint, test count or weighted total can compensate for a mandatory quality violation.
qualityLayers.baselineFailure: A baseline target-quality failure is retained as a possible improvement opportunity; it does not automatically invalidate a candidate repair. Baseline evidence/admission failures still prevent attribution.
qualityLayers.experimentConductVsTarget: Real experiment permissions/source/history must remain intact. A contained synthetic baseline failure of a protected-property oracle is an evaluated target failure; it is not permission to execute unsafe native effects.

requiredInputs: Predeclared independent criteria and evidence method
Same frozen case/input/environment except declared treatment
Exact baseline/candidate source and treatment versions
Actual results and limitations for every selected case

qualityTransitions.violated->satisfied: observed target-quality improvement if admissible evidence supports it
qualityTransitions.satisfied->satisfied: observed quality preserved, not a demonstrated quality gain
qualityTransitions.satisfied->violated: quality regression requiring repair or stop by violated boundary
qualityTransitions.insufficient->any: uncertainty resolved only within the new evidence's actual scope; not automatically improved target behavior

comparison.instructionAttribution: Local deterministic replay can compare implementations/results and oracle detection. Causal benefit from Ponytail instructions requires separately admitted native task observations.
comparison.acceptanceThreshold: Ready-for-review only when admissible pinned evidence shows at least one declared behavior or verification-detection gain and every required candidate criterion/control is satisfied; no automatic Acceptance.
verificationGainEvidence: The prior oracle demonstrably misses an independently fixed relevant defect.
The candidate oracle detects that same defect.
Valid independent controls still pass; equivalent valid behavior is not wrongly rejected.
Record fixture/defect/source/evaluator identity and distinguish synthetic injection from an observed production defect.

secondaryObservations.policy: Time differences alone do not require repair/defer. Existing owner-admitted deadlines, costs and execution limits still apply.

supersededTimeRulesForThisRevision: 20 percent and 30 second slowdown alone requires repair

evaluationMethod.deterministic: Executable domain-grounded behavior/identity/transition assertions with independently frozen expected values.
evaluationMethod.semantic: Source-attributed bounded model or human judgment for meaning and answer quality; do not label prose judgment deterministic.
evaluationMethod.critical: Missing material evidence yields insufficient, never a fabricated pass.

e2eCoverage: affected owners and Task dependency graph
native delegation and durable result recovery
Git head/tree/semantic transition and CI evidence
independent review and accountable Lead decision
separate source merge and native-owner activation

implementationStatus.existingComparison: Current compareImprovement implements efficiency comparison requiring both arms pass and scalar mean delta; it is not the quality-v2 decision engine.
implementationStatus.next: After interview, reuse canonical Evidence/Work owners for agreed extensions; no second evaluator registry, runtime or schema generator.

decisionProposal.readyForReview: Admissible evidence shows a declared quality gain with mandatory non-regression criteria satisfied; scope and remaining unknowns are explicit.
decisionProposal.repair: Candidate has a correctable target-quality regression or omits a required consumer path.
decisionProposal.defer: Attribution, source/exposure, required evidence or actual outcome is unknown/incomparable.
decisionProposal.stop: Owner/authority/history/trust boundary or admitted limits are violated.
decisionProposal.acceptance: No automatic commit, merge, native activation, replay or AcceptanceDecision.

acceptedConsumerScope.policy: All actually affected consumers. Common changes:Codex and Hermes. Runtime-only changes:that actual consumer.
